**CRITICAL UI INTERACTION PATTERNS:**
**SPINNERS/DROPDOWNS** (Two-stage interaction): 1. First click: Opens dropdown/dialog with options 2. Second click: Select option from expanded list (new state) 3. Result: Dialog closes, returns to original screen with selection
**FORMS**: Fill required fields systematically before submitting - Validate input formats (email, phone, etc.) - Test error states with invalid inputs - Complete logical field sequences
**LISTS**: Test both navigation and interaction patterns - Scroll to reveal more items when applicable - Select items to test detail views or actions
**NAVIGATION**: Follow logical user workflow patterns - Complete current screen interactions before navigating - Prioritize unvisited screens for coverage expansion
